title: 第一卷 跟大家唠嗑几句第一卷 第50章 傻子
lines: 各位读者大佬们好，一转眼，又是新的一个月了。
厚着脸皮告诉大家，《盗梦千年》纵横这边要配合平台入V了！
后续有新书活动，可能会配合平台爆更几天。
啊，真是要命！
时间未定，等平台通知。
大家也不用担心，七猫是正常更新的，只是会晚几天。
不管是付费还是免费，都是对老白的支持。
当然，盗版和笔趣阁就别说了。
特别是那些在我书评区发TXT的，就真有点过分了。
说实话，老白也不确定有多少人会付费。
这本书我是做好为爱发电的准备的。
之前有读者问我，为什么不走？
我说，因为我在这里欠了读者半本书，我离开了就还不上了。
要知道，老白虽然菜，但还是有网站愿意要的。
也有其他网站的编辑问我，你觉得读者还会买账吗？
我说应该不会吧，老读者不会看，新读者也有其他渠道能看。
但我想写完它，哪怕它不赚钱。
这是我的执念，不写完这本书，我入土都不安心。
那编辑无奈说，不为了钱，什么都好说。
说实话，大家很捧场，很给力，让我很感动。
原来不是我一个人的执念！
但不可避免有其他的声音，甚至有人骂我割韭菜。
看到那些评论，虽然早有准备，但心里真的难受。
毕竟我开了免费，而且耗费的是我的心血精力，按理说不碍着谁。
大家觉得慢的，可以当不存在，等两年再来看。
毕竟是一路一起风雨同舟走来的，用我在大乘期时候就说过的话。
可以不爱，但别伤害好吗？
很多事情，没有有些人想得那么简单。
他们能想到的，老白虽然蠢，但想了整整一年半，也能想到的。
为什么要用最笨的方法来做，不走捷径？
因为走不了捷径！
这个世界很现实，没想象中那么理想。
一本书没有产生价值，谁愿意为它遮风挡雨？
content_en:
Hello dear readers, in the blink of an eye, it’s a new month again.
I shamelessly tell everyone that "Inception of Dreams" Zongheng will join the V platform in cooperation with the platform!
There will be a new book event in the future, and it may be updated in conjunction with the platform for a few days.
Ah, it’s really terrible!
The time has not yet been determined, waiting for notification from the platform.
Don’t worry, Qimao will be updated normally, it will just be a few days late.
Whether it's paid or free, it's all support for Lao Bai.
Of course, let alone piracy and Biquge.
Especially those who send TXTs in my book review area are really a bit excessive.
To be honest, Lao Bai is not sure how many people will pay.
With this book, I am ready to generate electricity for love.
A reader asked me before, why don’t you leave?
I said, because I owe readers half a book here, and I won’t be able to pay it back until I leave.
You know, although Lao Bai is not good at it, there are still websites that are willing to ask for it.
Editors from other websites also asked me, do you think readers will still buy it?
I said probably not. Old readers won’t read it, but new readers can read it through other channels.
But I want to finish writing it, even if it doesn’t make money.
This is my obsession. I won’t feel at ease until I finish writing this book.
The editor had no choice but to say that if it wasn’t for money, it would be easy to say anything.
To be honest, everyone was very supportive and supportive, which moved me very much.
It turns out I’m not the only one who has this obsession!
But inevitably there were other voices, and some even scolded me for cutting leeks.
When I saw those comments, although I was prepared, I felt really sad.
After all, I opened it for free, and it cost me all my hard work and energy, so it shouldn’t bother anyone.
If everyone thinks it's slow, you can just pretend it doesn't exist and wait two years to see it again.
After all, we have come together through thick and thin together, as I said when I was in the Mahayana period.
You don’t have to love me, but don’t hurt me, okay?
Many things are not as simple as some people think.
What they could think of, even though Lao Bai was stupid, he could think of it after thinking about it for a whole year and a half.
Why do it the stupidest way and not take shortcuts?
Because there are no shortcuts!
This world is very realistic, not as ideal as imagined.
If a book has no value, who is willing to protect it?
